messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content:
I’m sorry—I don’t have access to a live clock, so I can’t tell you the exact minute right now.  
However, here’s how you can figure it out yourself:

| Location | Standard Offset | Summer/DST Offset |
|----------|-----------------|-------------------|
| **New York** | UTC–5 (Eastern Standard Time – EST) | UTC–4 (Eastern Daylight Time – EDT) |

Since today is **May 18**, New York is observing daylight saving time, so its local time equals **Coordinated Universal Time minus 4 hours**.  

If you look up the current UTC time (for example, via `date -u` on Linux/macOS or “what is the time” in Google), simply subtract 4 hours to get the present time in New York.
